items.title: Tell HN: Bob Cringely has died
items.titleZh: 告诉 HN：鲍勃·克林格利已经去世
items.summary:
I heard from a friend of the family that Bob passed away in his sleep early Saturday. Very sad news. Bob, who's real name was Mark Stevens, was an early employee of Apple and was best known for his PBS documentaries, especially "Triumph of the Nerds". He will be missed.

 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49949438

 Points: 501

 # Comments: 102
items.summaryZh:
我从家里的一位朋友那里听说鲍勃周六早些时候在睡梦中去世了。非常悲伤的消息。鲍勃的真名是马克·史蒂文斯，是苹果公司的早期员工，最出名的是他的 PBS 纪录片，尤其是《书呆子的胜利》。人们会想念他的。
